verdict.rationale: Gazebo can run fully headless via the `-s` server flag and exposes CLI tools plus gz-transport for programmatic introspection/control, suggesting most simulation functionality is scriptable outside the GUI. However, there is no explicit documentation claiming full feature parity between the GUI (which is plugin-based and includes visualization-only components) and the API/CLI surface. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or evidence that every GUI capability (especially visualization/plugin-specific GUI features) is exposed via API/CLI, and any third-party confirmation of parity.
